evaluation_basis: Assessed for independent production evidence export and prespecified sample sufficiency, not for return significance.

engineering_result.summary: Production export, evidence validation and the three-file GitHub Actions artifact completed; deterministic tests were 3/3.

scientific_result.summary: The snapshot was far below every preregistered minimum; no risk-ratio, alpha or live-readiness conclusion was authorized.

economic_result.summary: Cumulative simulated PAPER return and drawdown were approximately -0.0261%; this single-fill value has no inferential meaning.
